module_summary: UART transmitter: serializes bytes with phase machine (REST/LEAD/PAY/TAIL) clocked by timer wrap pulse.

anchors.name: ph
anchors.why: 4-phase state machine controlling serial transmission: REST→LEAD→PAY→TAIL.

anchors.name: tmr
anchors.why: Timing counter dividing clock by CLK_DIV to bit rate.

anchors.name: sr
anchors.why: Shift register holding transmitted data byte.

anchors.name: nb
anchors.why: Counts bits transmitted, triggers payload completion.

anchors.name: wrap
anchors.why: Timer wrap signal gates phase transitions and bit shifting.

anchors.name: grab
anchors.why: Load enable when ready and valid; latches tx_data into sr.

anchors.name: quiet
anchors.why: Idle indicator; gates data capture and timer updates.

anchors.name: tx_o
anchors.why: Serial output: high in REST/LEAD, payload bit in PAY, high in TAIL.

anchors.name: tx_valid
anchors.why: Input handshake: enables data capture when module is ready.

anchors.name: tx_ready
anchors.why: Output handshake: asserted during idle phase (quiet).

anchors.name: busy_o
anchors.why: Inverted busy: asserted when not in REST phase.

groups.name: Timing
groups.description: Timer and wrap signal generating bit-rate clock.

groups.name: Data Path
groups.description: Shift register and bit counter for serial transmission.

groups.name: Control Logic
groups.description: Decode ready/valid handshake and phase-dependent enables.

groups.name: Ports
groups.description: Data, handshake, and status signals to external interface.
